extracted.name: Honey Walnut Cream Cheese
extracted.description: This honey walnut cream cheese recipe uses only cream cheese, honey, and toasted walnuts for a sweet, wonderful spread for bagels, toast, and more.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese (such as Philadelphia®), softened
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place walnuts on a baking sheet. Bake until toasted and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Transfer walnuts to a plate to cool. When walnuts are cool, transfer to a resealable plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin.
Combine cream cheese, honey, and walnuts in a food processor and pulse until creamy.
